<thought>The dominant peak at m/z 182.0732 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 181.0659 Da. Matching this mass to a formula containing only C, H, and O yields C₁₃H₉O (neutral mass 181.06534 Da), which is within a few ppm of the calculated neutral mass and is consistent with the observed isotopic pattern (≈ 13 C atoms). Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C13H9O.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H9O</final_answer>
